title: a part of a string verifies only when it names the place in full
line: a part verifies against a candidate when it is the candidate's name, or a unit's name in its hierarchy, in full once case, punctuation, an abbreviated word (Mt., Twp) and the unit's own word (Township, Ward N) are set aside; a part that is only the start of a candidate's name (Cadillac Memorial Gardens West, a cemetery's name without its last word), a truncation (Hemp.) or a spelling near it (Worchester) is marked near in the candidate's checks and the string is a card with that candidate offered, never accepted

steps.say: three strings of the records the file does not carry: a cemetery written without its last word, a township's name misspelt, and Mount Holly abbreviated

place_string.raw: Cadillac Memorial Gardens West, Westland, Wayne County, Michigan, USA
Mt. Holly, Burlington, New Jersey, United States

steps.say: the resolver run on those and on five strings the file carries, with the geocoder's real answers in its cache

only: Cadillac Memorial Gardens West, Westland, Wayne County, Michigan, USA
Mt. Holly, Burlington, New Jersey, United States
Mount Holly, Burlington County, New Jersey, United States of America
Caln Twp, Caln, Chester, Pennsylvania, USA

place_string.raw: Cadillac Memorial Gardens West, Westland, Wayne County, Michigan, USA

expect.why: the string is the cemetery's name less its last word: the start of a name is not the name, so the one candidate does not verify and the string is not accepted

place_card.raw: Cadillac Memorial Gardens West, Westland, Wayne County, Michigan, USA
names: Cadillac Memorial Gardens West Cemetery, Westland, Wayne County, Michigan, United States

expect.why: the cemetery is offered on the card, its first part marked near and every other part verified
a spelling near Worcester is not Worcester: the township the owner's override asks for is offered, not accepted

names: Worcester Township, Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, United States

expect.why: Worcester Township is the card's candidate, Worchester marked near
a truncation is not the name: Hemp. is the start of Hempstead, and Hempstead is a town and a village in it

has: Town of Hempstead, Nassau County, New York, United States
Village of Hempstead, Town of Hempstead, Nassau County, New York, 11550, United States

expect.why: both Hempstead candidates are offered with the truncation marked near, so neither is a full match

place_string.raw: Mt. Holly, Burlington, New Jersey, United States

expect.why: Mt. is Mount, and the township's own word is set aside: Mt. Holly names Mount Holly Township in full

place_string.raw: Mount Holly, Burlington County, New Jersey, United States of America

raws: Mt. Holly, Burlington, New Jersey, United States
Mount Holly, Burlington County, New Jersey, United States of America

expect.why: the abbreviated and the written-out string are one place

place_string.raw: Caln Twp, Caln, Chester, Pennsylvania, USA

expect.why: Twp is Township: Caln Twp is Caln Township, and the string's Caln is the unit's name once its word is set aside
a ward's number is the unit's own word beside Northampton
